shapes.name: E01:title:22
shapes.text: Certificates a shipowner can verify on their own

shapes.name: E01:message:23
shapes.text: Fund a bounded local pilot of sovereign evidence cells. Do not fund Azure deployment yet.

shapes.name: E01:hero-meta:26
shapes.text: Phase 0: design, controls and evidence. No application and no Azure resource exists.

shapes.name: E02:title:2
shapes.text: A green-fuel premium is only paid if the certificate is believed

shapes.name: E02:message:3
shapes.text: Each delivery must become a certificate that survives a shipowner, an auditor and a dispute.

shapes.name: E02B:title:2
shapes.text: 8 stakeholders decide this, and the case names only 2

shapes.name: E02B:message:3
shapes.text: Whoever can fund it, approve a filing, open a meter or accept the evidence. None has been interviewed.

shapes.name: E02B:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Stated: the case study says so. Candidate: a hypothesis to confirm with that stakeholder.

shapes.name: E03:title:2
shapes.text: Reliability decides how much of the premium is kept

shapes.name: E03:message:3
shapes.text: The premium pool is the prize and trusted certificates protect it. How much is unknown: the business has supplied no figure.

shapes.name: E03:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Scenario figures are assumptions in a model, not facts. They show where value would come from.

shapes.name: E03:stat-label:7
shapes.text: premium revenue pool a year, year 3, base inputs

shapes.name: E03:stat-label:11
shapes.text: of it protected by the platform, base case

shapes.name: E03:stat-label:15
shapes.text: inputs supplied by the business so far

shapes.name: E03:placeholder-text:18
shapes.text: Evidence missing: Group delivery volumes, green-fuel premiums and dispute history

shapes.name: E04:title:2
shapes.text: Base case: real value, but no three-year payback

shapes.name: E04:message:3
shapes.text: Placeholder inputs give a negative three-year NPV (-$1.56M) and about 60 months to pay back. Volume decides it.

shapes.name: E04:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Break-even needs about 901 deliveries a year; the base case assumes 600. Doing nothing keeps the manual cost of about $985 per certificate and forgoes about $1.

shapes.name: E04:chart-title:5
shapes.text: Annual benefit by source, year 3, base case

shapes.name: E05:title:2
shapes.text: Today's manual process is not known well enough, and fails where it is known

shapes.name: E05:message:3
shapes.text: Records can be altered undetectably, effort grows with volume, and audit preparation is a document hunt.

shapes.name: E05:foot-note:4
shapes.text: The assessment is from the options analysis. The current systems themselves are not known (D-019, D-035).

shapes.name: E06:title:2
shapes.text: Four options on eleven criteria: only sovereign cells can be made to meet residency

shapes.name: E06:message:3
shapes.text: The cheapest option cannot show port residency. The recommended one pays for it in operational complexity.

shapes.name: E06:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Verdicts are the options analysis's own. Costs over three years: A $2.7M, B $3.8M (not like-for-like), C $5.2M.

shapes.name: E07:title:2
shapes.text: Recommend sovereign cells, a deterministic core and bounded agents

shapes.name: E07:message:3
shapes.text: Evidence stays in its port. Software computes and signs. AI drafts and explains, and never decides.

shapes.name: E07:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Design, not built. The group plane carries no raw or evidence-grade data.

shapes.name: E07:group-plane-text:6
shapes.text: Group plane  signed methodology and policy go down; only approved-flow metadata comes up (undecided, D-011)

shapes.name: E07:core-title:21
shapes.text: Deterministic services: software computes, signs, enforces

shapes.name: E07:core-sub:22
shapes.text: calculation under a versioned method · certificate signing · approvals · audit

shapes.name: E07:cell-b-text:31
shapes.text: Same contract; hosting may differ: an Azure region or a local host, decided per port.

shapes.name: E07:cell-n-text:32
shapes.text: One cell per jurisdiction, not per port.

shapes.name: E08:title:2
shapes.text: It wins on the hard constraints and pays for it in complexity

shapes.name: E08:message:3
shapes.text: Five decisive reasons, in order. Each ties to a stated requirement or constraint.

shapes.name: E08:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Conditions attached: if the sponsor will not pay for sovereignty, the choice is fewer ports, not a cheaper design that breaks residency.

shapes.name: E09:title:2
shapes.text: Agents draft. Services validate and issue. A person approves

shapes.name: E09:message:3
shapes.text: Five business agents work inside fixed boundaries; none can approve, file or change a method.

shapes.name: E09:break-text:41
shapes.text: Agents never hold the permission to approve or file

shapes.name: E09:break-text:43
shapes.text: Emissions come from versioned methods, never from a model

shapes.name: E09:break-text:45
shapes.text: Every step ends in a defined, auditable state

shapes.name: E10:title:2
shapes.text: Evidence stays in its port: everywhere else is conditional or prohibited

shapes.name: E10:message:3
shapes.text: A region name is not residency proof. Placement is proposed per data class and zone, and undecided means no.

shapes.name: E10:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Proposed rules. Yes permitted, Cond permitted only after a named decision, No prohibited, TBD undecided and treated as No.

shapes.name: E11:title:2
shapes.text: Watch a delivery become a certificate a shipowner can verify

shapes.name: E11:message:3
shapes.text: Two minutes. Real code on synthetic data. Every step is labelled, and a recording is announced as a recording.

shapes.name: E11:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Run: node harness/demo/run.mjs exec. Backup: 1 recorded run(s), each marked "notLive".

shapes.name: E11:placeholder-text:31
shapes.text: Evidence missing: Measured reduction in certificate processing time

shapes.name: E12:title:2
shapes.text: Measured: the rules do the work. AI value is unproven

shapes.name: E12:message:3
shapes.text: On 42 synthetic cases a conventional workflow completed 41. No language model has been run.

shapes.name: E12:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Synthetic, author-written, unreviewed; the holdout is not blind. No throughput, latency or availability test exists: there is no system to test.

shapes.name: E13:title:2
shapes.text: Base case: $5.2M over three years, and more per certificate than today

shapes.name: E13:message:3
shapes.text: Cost per certificate rises. The case rests on disputes and premium protection, not on labour.

shapes.name: E13:foot-note:4
shapes.text: One-time $2.3M; annual operating $985,308. 12 verified inputs (Azure list prices) and 79 scenario assumptions.

shapes.name: E14:title:2
shapes.text: Decision: fund a bounded local pilot. Not Azure deployment yet

shapes.name: E14:message:3
shapes.text: Approve Phase 1a on synthetic data, and supply four inputs that turn assumptions into numbers.

shapes.name: E14:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Revisit the whole case if confirmed volume is well below about 901 deliveries a year.

shapes.text: 99 requirements, 80 of them Must, in six families

shapes.name: T01:message:3
shapes.text: Case-study requirements are kept apart from assumptions, open questions and claims that still need verification.

shapes.name: T01:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Counts are read from the requirements baseline; a Must requirement without a decision is listed in the appendix.

shapes.text: Azure services are provisional leans, each with a residency check still to run

shapes.name: T02:foot-note:4
shapes.text: 16 roles are assessed in the service decision matrix. None is verified in a region and none is deployed.

shapes.name: T03:title:2
shapes.text: Thirteen flows are classified. Only some may leave the jurisdiction

shapes.name: T03:message:3
shapes.text: Edge links may be intermittent: events are buffered, signed and retried idempotently. Retries are duplicates, never new evidence.

shapes.name: T03:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Arrow colour: green allowed inside the jurisdiction, amber undecided, red forbidden by default. All 13 flows are in the appendix register.

shapes.name: T04:title:2
shapes.text: Four agents may reach L4. One stays at L3. None can approve or file

shapes.name: T04:message:3
shapes.text: L4 is a ceiling on autonomy inside a fixed boundary, not a permission to act commercially, regulatorily or on infrastructure.

shapes.name: T04:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Proposed ceilings. Approval, filing, method change and infrastructure change are never agent actions.

shapes.name: T04:agent-why:20
shapes.text: Ingests and binds source evidence as received within a fixed catalogue

shapes.name: T04:agent-why:38
shapes.text: Assembles packs; every outward or commercial step is human

shapes.name: T04:agent-why:47
shapes.text: Posts events derived from signed source events…

shapes.name: T04:agent-why:56
shapes.text: Answers in-policy questions directly to customers, with sampled review

shapes.name: T04:levels-legend:57
shapes.text: L0 No AI   ·   L1 Assistive   ·   L2 Drafting   ·   L3 Conditional action   ·   L4 Bounded autonomy   ·   L5 Unbounded autonomy

shapes.name: T05:title:2
shapes.text: 59 controls in seven families. 9 cannot be tested until a product exists

shapes.name: T05:message:3
shapes.text: Shipowner isolation is enforced per tenant by the cell, not by the agent. Each control names the requirement it serves.

shapes.name: T05:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Security review: three HIGH, eleven MEDIUM and two LOW. Candidate oracles test the rules on synthetic data; no control is implemented in a product.

shapes.name: T06:title:2
shapes.text: Evidence is a signed chain; the certificate binds to its hash

shapes.name: T06:message:3
shapes.text: A verifier needs only the certificate, the evidence files and a trust set it supplies. Tampering is detected, not prevented.

shapes.name: T06:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Recorded run (not live): 5 signed events, chain verified, 2,500 kg delivered, 5 receipts, tamper attempt detected.

shapes.name: T06:tamper-text:41
shapes.text: Tampering is detected, not prevented. Change any event, receipt, manifest or certificate and a signature or hash no longer matches. An independent external anch

shapes.name: T07:message:3
shapes.text: The argument is structural: each cell scales independently. No throughput, latency or scale test has been run, because there is no system to test.

shapes.name: T08:title:2
shapes.text: Recovery stays inside each jurisdiction. Targets are unset and untested

shapes.name: T08:message:3
shapes.text: Under failure the system refuses, waits or escalates. It never guesses. Regional outage and recovery are designed, not tested.

shapes.name: T08:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Edge outage, tamper, replay and injection are tested on candidate contracts. Region outage is not.

shapes.name: T08:placeholder-text:6
shapes.text: Evidence missing: Tested recovery against agreed RPO and RTO

shapes.name: T09:title:2
shapes.text: Observability is designed per cell. Nothing is instrumented yet

shapes.name: T09:message:3
shapes.text: Logs and metrics stay with the data they describe. Telemetry is classified so it cannot leak what the cell must not export.

shapes.name: T09:foot-note:4
shapes.text: A recorded observability demonstration exists (not live). No application emits telemetry.

shapes.name: T09:placeholder-text:6

shapes.text: Four arms were scored. Both language-model arms are not run

shapes.name: T10:message:3
shapes.text: The decision rule is fixed first: use rules by default and admit a model only where it beats the measured baseline.

shapes.name: T10:foot-note:4
shapes.text: Synthetic, author-written, unreviewed cases; the holdout is not blind. Model selection is deferred (D-028).
